name: Sakurai Aya
source:
Ai's best friend. She has a crush on Ai's boyfriend Keiichi but doesn't realize Ai is already dating him. She's devastated when she finds out but Ai promises to share.

She's often very shy but goes along with what Ai wants.

In the original game her eyes and hair are brown. In the DVD version her eyes are green and her hair is red.
